response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack engineering skills, leadership in open-source projects, and experience with scalable systems, though his background lacks direct experimentation platform expertise. His AI-agent infrastructure work and cross-team tooling align well with the role's focus on foundational systems, but the absence of explicit experimentation/telemetry platform experience tempers the fit.
strengths: Proven technical leadership in architecting scalable systems (e.g., GISCollective, Optilyz's Direct Mail platform).
Hands-on experience with AI-agent infrastructure and developer tooling (re:cinq), relevant to AI-first growth systems.
Strong cross-functional collaboration (e.g., partnerships with NGOs, data science teams at Dunnhumby).
concerns: No explicit experience building experimentation platforms or feature-flagging systems (key requirement).
Limited exposure to statistical methods or bias detection in experimentation (preferred qualification).
Primary languages (TypeScript, D) are not among the preferred ones (C++, Java, Python, C#).
